title: 500 Condors Prove Near-Extinction Can Reverse
hook: The California condor rebounded to 500—and lead still threatens it.
closing: Recovery works only if the surviving birds stop being poisoned.
question: Could this comeback survive lead?

segments.say: Around 500 condors live today, turning a near-extinction into a real comeback.
The population passed 300 only in 2008, proving species recovery takes decades.
Lead fragments cause about 50% of wild condor deaths, putting the comeback at risk.
